title: Ex-CEC Quraishi’s Manmohan Singh claim sparks row
description: A claim by former chief election commissioner SY Quraishi that then prime minister Manmohan Singh told him, “If that is what you think, I will commit suicide,” after being confronted over Congress leaders’ attacks on the Election Commission of India (ECI) has become the most politically explosive revelation in Quraishi’s forthcoming book, “India and I: A Hundred Memories, Not a Memoir”
